stages.reference: Create a close reference for mid-gray stained glass used in an old, sober stone settlement. Its neutral smoky tint should admit soft light through a broad, calm translucent body, lighter than black glass but far removed from colorless windowpanes. Very slight variations in thickness create gentle cloudy depths; imperfect cooling leaves faint waviness only upon careful inspection. Aged use has dulled the polish without turning the material into dirty concrete. Hold a cool-neutral gray family with restrained value range and diffuse light, letting real transmission establish its glass identity. Avoid polished steel, mirror effects, marble veins, stark white scratches, opaque paint, deep cracks, obvious windows or geometric decorative patterns. The paired detail layer must share this muted gray body.
